caption:
Two giant arches in one sky. One is hours old. One predates Earth.

The pale band is our Milky Way: stars, gas and dust, very far away.
The green glow is an aurora. It is only hours old.
An aurora is made of energized atoms and molecules, close by in Earth’s upper air.

What the astronomers say: the Sun links the two, because it is a star of the Milky Way and it sends out the particles that make aurora.
